notes: Portable 0-5 cm SoilGrids expansion across 105 committed Earth fine candidates; not a global exhaustive survey.
SoilGrids values are 250 m global model predictions, not local measurements.
Each observation carries its own depth interval; only 0-5 cm was acquired in this expansion.
Source observations retain score_role=evidence_only; the versioned feature-eligibility registry may promote gated 0-5 cm means to query similarity. Q05/Q95 remain uncertainty evidence.
Raw rasters are not committed; response checksums are recorded per request.
The 105 AOIs are existing fine candidates; values join by exact area_id, not proximity.

source_provenance.model_uncertainty: Q0.05 and Q0.95 are separate SoilGrids prediction-quantile records per area/property/depth. They are not a confidence interval for the AOI mean.

rate_limit.backoff: exponential, honours Retry-After, capped at 30 s
